definitions.full: H6023. Amashsay עֲמַשְׁסַי proper name, masculine (probably textual error for foregoing, Ol § 2771 , compare Thes 1044 ); — a priest Neh 11:13 , Αμασεια[-σαι] , = מַעֲשַׂי 1Chr 9:12 ( Μαασαια[-σει] ). ענב (√ of following; compare Late Hebrew עֵנָב = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic id. ; Sabean אנעב vineyards SabDenkm 47 ; Mordtm ZMG xli (1887), 309, 364 ; עִנָּכָא ᵑ7 ; perhaps also Assyrian inbu , fruit (and not = אֵב q. v. ), compare Hom A. und A.94 ).
